provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled isotropic encounter approximation k_diff=4*pi*(D_A+D_B)*(r_A+r_B)*N_A*1000 in L/(mol*s). A finite common intrinsic contact rate obeys1/k_observed=1/k_diff+1/k_intrinsic in every medium. All radii and diffusion sums are independently supplied; no change of contact chemistry is assumed without testing.
target: Recover the common positive intrinsic rate and check every medium, rather than assigning k_observed=k_diff or fitting an independent intrinsic parameter to each observation.
scope: Stipulated transport/finite-contact model, not an actual reactive mechanism, synthesis rate recommendation or proof of diffusion-limited chemistry.
